They are in a second plate; we could treat as by-well liquids? Actually each colony suspension is in a well of source plate; we take 1 ul from each. Since they are distinct, we could treat as sample_{i} with index number because order matters? Not specified which colony goes where; just add 1 ul from each of 16 colony resuspensions. Could be any order; we can treat as free group with members each having a sample liquid (unnumbered). Since they are not numbered, we can use generic "colony" liquid? But better to treat as sample_{i} with index "any" because they are treated alike (each gets 1 ul). Use pattern for numbered samples? Not needed. Use "colony" as reagent? No it's sample material. We'll define liquid "colony_{i}" with pattern capturing number, count 16, index "any". Then each well gets 1 ul of that colony liquid.

PCR mix: 20 ul per well. Define reagent "pcr_mix".

Destination: PCR plate. Need to know if another labware of same kind on deck? Not mentioned, so auto.

Thus variant: name "16 colonies free", why, pinned empty, groups: one group with members list of 16 entries each {"pcr_mix":20, "colony_{i}":1}. Need to expand i from 1 to 16.
